Title: Generative AI Engineer
Description: We are Kuona ( kuona.ai )! We are revolutionizing revenue optimization for ​Consumer ​Goods and ​Retailers through cutting-edge artificial intelligence. With our AI platform, we help brands like Coca-Cola and Oxxo manage pricing, promotions, and inventory with never-before-seen accuracy.​ ​Kuona’s AI ​SaaS solutions provide real-time, data-driven insights that maximize profitability.​ With top-tier strategic partners, we are expanding across LATAM, and beyond. We are setting the global standard in AI-enhanced revenue optimization.​ Join us if you're curious, innovative, and intent on solving complex challenges using AI. Join us and be a part of the team that is shaping the future of commercial intelligence on a worldwide stage. We're hiring an AI Engineer to own and build across our two AI product lines: ExpertAI — our agentic platform for natural-language querying, ontology generation, and task automation. BlueMeth — our analytics agents that automate revenue analysis for clients. This is a hybrid build-and-own role: you'll be a hands-on engineer and hold internal product ownership. You'll ship agents into production, decide how they behave and evolve, and work directly with clients and our data science team. The mission is ambitious — radically change how our products integrate and identify and automate the human judgment that today lives in people's heads. What you'll do Design, build, and maintain agentic workflows with PydanticAI / LangGraph — from prompting and skill design to purpose-built tools. Own the product roadmap for ExpertAI and BlueMeth agents: decide what they do, prioritize the backlog, and communicate clearly with stakeholders. Build and optimize GraphRAG pipelines, structured outputs, and retrieval systems on Postgres, PGVector, and Redshift. Work directly with clients and Customer Success to turn real problems into agent capabilities. Keep production healthy: observability with Langfuse and OpenTelemetry, and solid software design discipline. Required 3+ years of Python — async, Pydantic, FastAPI, clean-code practices. Hands-on experience taking LLM-powered agents from demo to production. Solid command of prompting strategies: CoT, ReAct, structured output, prompt caching, RAG variants. Real understanding of agent harness design — you can explain the difference between a workflow, a tool, a skill, and a prompt. Working familiarity with AWS (Bedrock, S3, ECR, Lambda, Redshift) and Docker. Product sense: you can write a clear spec, prioritize a backlog, and explain technical decisions to non-engineers. Fluent English and Spanish — both are essential; the role is client-facing across LATAM. Nice to have (or you'll grow into it here) Background in data science, ML, or time-series analysis — our agents live inside an analytics product. Experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise analytics environments. Kubernetes. Experience mentoring or leading other engineers — this role can grow toward technical leadership. Logistics Remote, working in LATAM-compatible hours.
